text: To what extent does the government provide effective public services to the people of
your country? [30]
Discuss the view that the news media should never be censored in your country. [30]
To what extent are art galleries and museums still necessary? [30]
Marriage is no longer necessary in modern society. Evaluate this view. [30]
New medicines should always be fully tested before people use them. To what extent do
you agree with this statement? [30]
To what extent is your country adequately prepared for natural disasters? [30]
All new house-building projects should include some green spaces within their plans.
Evaluate this view. [30]
Advertising has become an unwelcome feature of our lives. To what extent do you agree
with this statement? [30]
People should be allowed to protest in any way they choose. Evaluate this statement. [30]
International aid benefits the people providing the aid more than the people receiving it.
